howItWorks.title: How MyJudicial Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps from your legal problem to your solution.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Tell our AI Triage Assistant about your situation. It analyses your case, identifies the legal area, and matches you with the right specialist — all in under 2 minutes.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Review verified lawyer profiles with fixed transparent fees, star ratings from real clients, and real-time availability. Use our interactive map to find specialists near you.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Confirm your consultation with MTN MoMo or Airtel Money. Your payment is held in escrow and only released after your session is completed to your satisfaction.

whyMyJudicial.title:
Legal help that is fair,

fast, and fully transparent
whyMyJudicial.desc: We built MyJudicial because too many Rwandans were unable to access quality legal help quickly or affordably. Our platform removes the barriers — long waits, opaque fees, and geographic limits — and replaces them with verified experts, fixed pricing, and instant booking.

item1.title: Verified Legal Professionals
item1.desc: Every lawyer is BAR certified, identity-checked, and reviewed before appearing on the platform.

item2.title: Transparent Fixed Pricing
item2.desc: See the exact consultation fee before you book. No hidden costs, no surprise bills.

item3.title: Mobile Money Integration
item3.desc: Pay instantly with MTN MoMo or Airtel Money. Funds held in secure escrow until consultation is complete.

item4.title: Same-Day Booking
item4.desc: Many lawyers offer same-day and next-day slots. Book in minutes, not weeks.

item5.title: AI-Assisted Matching
item5.desc: Our AI triage assistant analyses your case and matches you with the right specialist instantly.

item6.title: Find Lawyers Near You
item6.desc: Use our interactive map to discover verified legal experts in your district.

footer.desc: Connecting Rwandan citizens with verified legal expertise. Trusted, secure, and accessible legal aid for everyone.
